_source: Principality of Stone Kingdom Gear (owner scan 2026-11-03): 14 kinds ×2 + 2 Story cards; slot icon = Support pouch except the two Story cards

gear.name: Petrified Chest Wound
gear.text:
You must equip this card if you own it. You cannot discard this card in any way.
When you die, return this card to the box (you do not own it anymore).

gear.name: Petrified Hand
gear.text:
You must equip this card if you own it. You cannot discard this card in any way.
When you die, return this card to the box (you do not own it anymore).

gear.name: Regional Map
gear.text:
Deploy 1.
[Exhaust] During Delve, you may move through Shortcuts.
2 [Heat] [Exhaust] When you perform a [Move action], gain +1 Speed [Speed] for that movement.

gear.name: Parasite Bait
gear.text:
+1 Fortitude [Fortitude].
1 [Heat] [Exhaust] When you are about to suffer Parasitize X, lower X by 1 (to a minimum of 0).
[GRAVE] 1 [Heat] [Discard] Discard 1 Armor [Armor] token from anywhere.

gear.name: Dismantling Hooks
gear.text:
1 [Heat] [Exhaust] When you are about to attack, you may change up to 3 Break [Break] tokens in the Knight Pool into Opening [Opening] tokens and vice versa.
[Discard] Ignore a Rotation.

gear.name: Firefly Lantern
gear.text:
2 [Heat] [Exhaust] Wander.
2 [Heat] [Exhaust] Look at the top BP card of the closest Monster.
[JUDICIUM] Gain +1 Precision [Precision].

gear.name: Rust Dust
gear.text:
Power Re-roll 1.
During an Attack ignore up to X Armor [Armor] tokens, where X is the number of Bane [Bane] tokens you have.
Start of your turn: Bane 1.

gear.name: Spikesole Boots
gear.text:
You may reduce suffered Drags and Pulls by 1.
[Move action] Gain Rocksteady and Stalwart until your next turn.
[MAJOR] Gain +1 [Heat] to use this card's ability instead of its regular cost.

gates.text: Gain +1 [Heat] to use this card's ability instead of its regular cost.

unclear: 비용 아이콘(달리는 사람 박스)을 [Move action]으로 판독

gear.name: Pauldron of a Cursed Knight
gear.text:
Your Heat Limit [Heat Limit] becomes 9. You cannot lose [Heat] in any way.
[JUDICIUM] [Discard] Second Chance.

gear.name: Adaptable Haversack
gear.text:
2 [Heat] [Exhaust] You may exchange one of your Weapon [Gear] cards for one Weapon from your Knight Armory. You may use this ability as a [Reaction].
[Exhaust] Unexhaust 1 Weapon [Gear] card.

gear.name: Sack of Possessions
gear.text:
When you discard another Gear [Gear] card, you may place it underneath this card.
X [Heat] [Discard] Return X cards from underneath this card to your Knight.

gear.name: Petrified Shrine Statue
gear.text:
Start of Clash: Draw a Judicium without resolving it, then return it to the deck. The next time you would draw a Judicium, resolve that Judicium instead.
1 [Heat] [Exhaust] Block or Defy, [red oval icon].
[GRAVE] X [Heat] [Discard] Discard X Armor [Armor] tokens from anywhere.

gates.text: X [Heat] [Discard] Discard X Armor [Armor] tokens from anywhere.

unclear: 'Block or Defy,' 뒤 빨간 타원 아이콘 미확인 (Eudes-Blessed Lance와 같은 아이콘)

gear.name: Iron Crow
gear.text:
Armor-piercing 2.
[JUDICIUM] [Discard] Draw a Judicium. If you survive, discard all Armor [Armor] tokens from anywhere.

gates.text: [Discard] Draw a Judicium. If you survive, discard all Armor [Armor] tokens from anywhere.

gear.name: Tenebrae-Infused Gauntlets
gear.text:
Deadly.
[Exhaust] Re-roll your Crit die, even if you already re-rolled it during this roll.
[JUDICIUM] 2 [Heat] [Exhaust] When your Attack hits, gain a Crit Chance.

gates.text: 2 [Heat] [Exhaust] When your Attack hits, gain a Crit Chance.

gear.name: Reverse Curse Charm
gear.text:
+1 Insight [Insight]. Bane Limit +2. Poison Limit +2. Gain +1 Speed [Speed] for each Bane [Bane] token you have. You cannot perform Armor Rolls.
[GRAVE] [Discard] Before an Evasion Roll, gain +X Evasion [Evasion], where X is the number of your Bane [Bane] tokens.

gates.text: [Discard] Before an Evasion Roll, gain +X Evasion [Evasion], where X is the number of your Bane [Bane] tokens.
